text:
In the palace of the essence of the <term>dharmadhatu</term> <gloss>the realm of reality</gloss>, which is supreme above all in the three realms, he resides together with a great assembly of monks and a great assembly of <term>bodhisattvas</term> <gloss>enlightened beings</gloss>. These are: the <term>bodhisattva</term> <gloss>enlightened being</gloss> Great Being Non-Conceptual, and Non-Conceptual Radiance, and Non-Conceptual Moon, and Non-Conceptual Hero, and Non-Conceptual Master of Teaching the Dharma, and Non-Conceptual Essence, and Non-Conceptual

<summary>This passage describes the assembly of monks and bodhisattvas residing with the Buddha in the supreme palace of the non-conceptual realm of reality.</summary>
<keywords>dharmadhatu, bodhisattva, non-conceptual, three realms, assembly</keywords>
